title: Rikudo
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: After his father's death, young Riku Azami is left with an addicted mother and her abusive drug dealer, until a yakuza debt collector and former boxer, Kyosuke Tokorozawa, teaches him how to punch. That punch saves his life but makes him a killer, and he grows up in a world of crime and loss. The seinen boxing drama follows Riku fighting his way up the ranks as tragedy keeps striking those who care for him.
life_message: A person with nothing can still choose to fight forward, and the bonds formed through discipline and struggle give life worth.
